title: Backhand Drive Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 134bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
Ball to your off side
Two hand or one hand
Turn early turn deep
Balance is the key

[Whisper verse]
Feet step to the ball
Shoulders rotate full coil
Paddle back to the hip line
Grip pressure five out of ten

Contact in front of the body
Waist height window
Level swing through the line
Flat face square at impact

[Tribal drop chant]
Backhand drive backhand drive
Turn and step turn and step
Vamos firme pa lante
Backhand drive backhand drive

[Whisper verse]
Target down the line deep
Or cross court angle wide
Medium pace flat path
Clear the net by two feet

Follow through across the body
Return to ready balanced
Reset the feet shoulder width
Breath out and ready paddle

[Tribal drop chant]
Backhand drive backhand drive
Turn and step turn and step
Vamos firme pa lante
Backhand drive backhand drive

[Whisper outro]
Turn deep
Step through
Turn deep
Step through
